First desktop build of PyPath (Windows/macOS/Linux), via Tauri.

**Unsigned build** — no Apple or Microsoft developer certificate. macOS will say the app is from an unidentified developer; right-click the app and choose Open the first time to run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn; choose More info, then Run anyway.

Works fully offline after install: lessons, the sandbox, and running/checking Python code never need a network connection. Progress saves to a local file you control (see Settings inside the app). Signing in, cloud sync, and classroom features still need a connection when used, same as the website.

See the repository README's Desktop app section for save locations, backup/restore, and known limitations.
